headline: Gains Consolidated As Every Front Falls Quiet
war_summary: Three hours on from the last edition the wire brings a lull, with not a single base change recorded in any region in the past two hours. The overnight work is now entered on the map: Fisherman's Row stands nine Colonial to none after twenty-seven changes in the day, fourteen in six hours about Arcadia and Eidolo; Linn Mercy stands eleven Colonial to none after fourteen changes; and Callahan's Passage stands ten Warden to none after nine changes about The Latch and Crumbling Post. Godcrofts remains nine Colonial to none after twenty-eight changes, twelve in six hours about The Axehead and Fleecewatch, while Stlican Shelf holds six Warden to three Colonial after forty-seven changes and Weathered Expanse six to three after forty-five changes about Frostmarch and Wightwalk amid the heaviest day's losses at 10,369 Colonial to 11,921 Warden. Stonecradle, three to six, has logged no change in six hours, with Farranac Coast and Viper Pit likewise quiet in that span while Mooring County shows three earlier changes at The Wind Hills.
